_comment: Registry of wire format v1 keys (ADR-VJGJ). Every implementation is tested against it; docs/protocol.md is generated from it. Revisions inside v1 only add optional fields (1.1 = ADR-B0B4, 1.2 = ADR-6RMH, 1.3 = ADR-ZKD1, 1.4 = ADR-RH0Y).

eventTypes.name: pageview
eventTypes.description: A page was viewed. `y` is omitted on the wire.

eventTypes.name: custom event
eventTypes.description: A named event with optional properties.

eventTypes.name: identify
eventTypes.description: Links the visitor to a site-supplied id.

eventTypes.name: engagement
eventTypes.description: Sent when a page is left: engaged time and scroll depth.

eventTypes.name: error
eventTypes.description: Reserved for JavaScript errors; not used yet.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Protocol version. Always the first field of the header line; a decoder rejects versions it does not support.

fields.name: project key
fields.description: Public project (site) key that routes the batch to a site.

fields.name: screen
fields.description: Viewport size as WIDTHxHEIGHT in CSS pixels.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Browser language tag.

fields.name: identity
fields.description: Identify id supplied by the site; the collector stores only a keyed hash of it.

fields.name: tracker version
fields.description: Version of the tracker script that built the batch. Not the protocol version `v`. Stored per event for diagnosis.

fields.name: timezone offset
fields.description: Visitor offset from UTC in minutes at the time of the batch, negative west of UTC (120 for Kyiv in summer, -300 for New York in winter). The zone name is not collected. Used for local-time reports, not for geography.

fields.name: client brands
fields.description: Client-hint brands, each written `Brand/major`; the major version follows the last slash. Raw signal for server-side device detection (ADR-ZKD1); the collector discards it after detection.

fields.name: client mobile flag
fields.description: Client-hint mobile flag, 1 or 0. Raw signal, discarded after detection.

fields.name: client platform
fields.description: Client-hint platform name. Raw signal, discarded after detection.

fields.name: client platform major version
fields.description: Major version of the client-hint platform version only. Tells Windows 11 (13 and above) from Windows 10. Raw signal, discarded after detection.

fields.name: maximum touch points
fields.description: `navigator.maxTouchPoints`. Raw signal, discarded after detection.

fields.name: coarse primary pointer
fields.description: 1 when the primary pointer is coarse (finger), else 0. Raw signal, discarded after detection.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Absolute event time, epoch milliseconds. Present on the first event of a batch only.

fields.name: delta
fields.description: Milliseconds since the previous event (may be negative). Used on every event after the first; decoders turn it into an absolute `ts`.

fields.name: event type
fields.description: Event type, see the event type table. Omitted for a pageview (0).

fields.name: event name
fields.description: Name of a custom event. Names starting with `$` are reserved for automatic events.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Page path without query string, except campaign parameters and click ids.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Page title.

fields.name: referrer
fields.description: External referrer as host and path, or an internal path.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Short labels on an event, separated by commas. A comma inside a tag is written `%2C`. At most 10 tags of 32 characters; the tracker enforces it and the collector drops the excess.

fields.name: property
fields.description: Custom property. The property name follows `p.` and is escaped (`:` as `%3A`). Values are strings; booleans are 1 and 0.

fields.name: engaged time
fields.description: Time the page was visible and active before it was left.

fields.name: scroll depth
fields.description: Maximum scroll depth reached, 0 to 100.

fields.name: largest contentful paint
fields.description: Web Vitals LCP.

fields.name: interaction to next paint
fields.description: Web Vitals INP.

fields.name: cumulative layout shift
fields.description: Web Vitals CLS, a unitless decimal.

fields.name: first contentful paint
fields.description: Web Vitals FCP.

fields.name: time to first byte
fields.description: Web Vitals TTFB.

queryParameters.name: batch age
queryParameters.description: Milliseconds between the moment the tracker built the batch and the moment this attempt is sent, a query parameter of the collect request and not part of the body. A missing or invalid value counts as 0.
